title: Fellowship - Movie Show
summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai North End organised a movie fellowship on Friday, 2nd October, with members enjoying the movie Drishyam 3 at PVR Lido during the 7:30 PM show.
description: Rotary Club of Mumbai North End organised a movie fellowship on Friday, 2nd October, with members enjoying the movie Drishyam 3 at PVR Lido during the 7:30 PM show. The evening provided a wonderful opportunity for members to relax, bond and strengthen friendships through fellowship.
